assertions.basis: keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f): its Parser.msgParsator, given this framed stream, yields for more bytes because the -V attachment group's quadlet count runs past the stream (src/keri/core/parsing.py, 'while len(ims) < pags: yield'); under the adapter protocol's end-of-input rule that is a rejection, not a wait.

description: A KERI 1.0 inception, then a 1.00 -V attachment group of size 30 quadlets holding 23 (an -A of one signature), at the end of the stream. In the 1.00 table -V counts quadlets. The adapter protocol makes the end of the input final, so an implementation may not wait for more bytes.
title: keripy 1.x: reject an attachment group that runs past the stream
